Sub: Intimation of schedule of Q1FY27 Earnings Call 
Ref: Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”) 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations, as amended 
from time to time, we would like to inform you that the officials of the Company will be 
attending a Results Conference Call to discuss on Unaudited standalone and consolidated 
financial results of the Company for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 as per the details below: 
 
Day, Date & Time 
Type of Event 
Wednesday, August 12, 2026 at 10:00 A.M IST  Q1FY27 Earnings Call 
 
Discussions will be based on publicly available information. No unpublished price sensitive 
information (UPSI) is intended to be discussed during the interactions. 
 
The above disclosure is available on the website of the Company www.nephroplus.com 
 
A copy of the invitation is attached for your information. 
 
Yours sincerely, 
For Nephrocare Health Services Limited 
(Formerly Nephrocare Health Services Private Limited) 
 
 
Kishore Kathri
